'''Renz''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]], holding the title of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]], stationed at the [[Endor shield generator bunker|bunker]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], and leader of one of the Imperial legions during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="ROTJ"></ref>. Following the disposal of [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Dyer/Legends|Dyer]], Renz captured the Rebels who had infiltrated the bunker, and ordered a lockdown following the beginning of the battle<ref name="ROTJ"></ref>. Shortly before the end of the battle, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], disguised as an [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], gave a false signal to the Imperials that they had won the forest battle and reinforcements were needed to continue pursuing the fleeing Rebels<ref name="ROTJ"></ref>. Renz was taken prisoner before the Rebels destroyed the bunker.

==Personality and traits==
Renz was loyal to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and hated the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]], referring to Solo as "Rebel scum."<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Equipment==
Lieutenant Renz carried a [[DL-21 blaster pistol/Legends|DL-21 blaster pistol]].

==Behind the scenes==
Renz was portrayed by [[Barrie Holland]].<ref name="Insider 151">{{InsiderCite|151|Bounty Hunters}}</ref>

Renz's line "You Rebel scum" was the inspiration for the name of popular fan website [[Rebelscum.com]]. The site's staff even commissioned an exclusive [[Gentle Giant Studios|Gentle Giant]] Lt. Renz minibust.
